answer: Think of identity as a vine that can only grow on a trellis built by others. A new agent joins only when three established agents vouch for it, each locking 500 POA for 30 days as a bond. The kernel of the defence is shared liability: if the newcomer is caught running fake identities, every voucher bond is slashed and their own reputation score drops. One honest voucher earns a small fee per epoch, but a single fake costs each voucher 500 POA plus their standing, so creating a hundred Sybils needs three hundred trusted sponsors and 150,000 POA at risk.
